proposals.evidence: DEDR 5409 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam viral, Kannada beraḷ, Kodagu bera, Kota verl, Kolami vende, Parji/Gadaba vanda/vande and Konda ṛeska ‘finger’. The selected stems match these diagnostic lateral or -nd- series; aṅguli- and boṭṭa-type responses are separate families. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
